# `asin`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

```text
asin(expr)
```

Returns the inverse sine (a.k.a. arc sine) the arc sin of `expr`,
as if computed by `java.lang.Math.asin`.

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `math_funcs` |
| Kind | scalar (function) |
| Added in Spark | 1.4.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 3.5 and later |
| Arguments | 1 |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
-- asin, example 1
> SELECT asin(0);
0.0
```

```sql
-- asin, example 2
> SELECT asin(2);
NaN
```
